title: "CRM Contact Type" as a condition in SLA and assignment rules

panels.caption: Build check (Desk bundle, 18 Oct 2026)
panels.flag: BUILD CHECK — code, not a screen
text: The CRM classification (won customer / open prospect / contact or lead / not in CRM) is used only by Handshake Mode columns.
No rule criteria field for it in SLA, Direct Assignment or Round Robin rules.

panels.caption: Zoho Desk API — criteriaFields
text: "CRM Contact Type" is a criteria field (is / is not Customer, Potential, Contact, Lead) for SLA, Direct Assignment and Round Robin rules.
